title: AI4ALL Ignite Fellow — Wind Energy Site Suitability Project
highlights: Combined the NREL Wind Toolkit with the US Wind Turbine Database on the basis of physical proximity, creating a labeled geospatial dataset of 120K+ grid cells for turbine-site prediction.
